title: Frame-Wise Cross-Modal Matching for Video Moment Retrieval

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Frame-Wise Cross-Modal Matching for Video Moment Retrieval Video moment retrieval targets at retrieving a golden moment in a video for a given natural language query.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: To avoid the limitations, researchers recently attempt to directly predict the relevant moment boundaries without the requirement to generate video clips first.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: To tackle those problems, early approaches adopt the sliding window or uniform sampling to collect video clips first and then match each clip with the query to identify relevant clips.

methods.name: Multi-Modal Fusion and Feature Enhancement
methods.evidence_sentence: One mainstream approach is to generate a multimodal feature vector for the target query and video frames (e.g., concatenation) and then use a regression approach upon the multimodal feature vector for boundary detection.

methods.name: Query-Conditioned Frame/Clip Selection
methods.evidence_sentence: To tackle those problems, early approaches adopt the sliding window or uniform sampling to collect video clips first and then match each clip with the query to identify relevant clips.
